title: Community DER Education & Outreach — Cornell Sustainable Consulting
description: Delivered a semester-long consulting engagement for T-GEN (Tompkins Green Energy Network), producing regulatory research, demographic strategy, and public-facing communications supporting a 150-day outreach campaign for Ithaca's Community Choice Aggregation program. Designed five educational posters on Distributed Energy Resources and contributed to an explanatory video bridging technical energy policy content for general audiences.
